title: Michael driven back to base by a sergeant after the incident
place_text: Ellsworth AFB missile field, South Dakota

tellings.quote: Next thing I know I was riding back with somebody. I was riding back with sergeant.

plain: Michael Johnson, a former US Air Force guard, says that around November 1977 he and a fellow guard had a strange encounter in the field of nuclear missile sites run from Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota. Speaking on the show of a podcast host, Jesse Michels, he says that his next memory after the incident is riding back to base with a sergeant, without knowing how he got there. If true, it would be part of a story in which two guards at a nuclear site lost time after meeting something not human.
